column1: # Folketingsvalgene den 22. April 1918 med Omvalget i Odense Amts 6. Valgkreds den 23. Juli 1918 og Suppleringsvalg 1915-18 (Statistiske Meddelelser, 4. Række, 57. Bind, 1. Hefte); constituency tables outside the capital pages 56-116 (Tabel 3), Færøerne page 117 (Tabel 4), the Bogense rerun page 153, by-elections page 145; the capital's list election (Tabel 1) is in cph-1918-04-22.tsv. Party letters as printed in the volume's name register; the candidate with the most votes is the elected member; the volume does not mark incumbents
# note: titles transcribed as printed; Grdejer expanded to Gaardejer; HRSagfører kept abbreviated; Randers 2 Harboe and several others have no residence printed where blank
# note: page 110 has the columns of the left table printed as "Heraf stemte | Antal Vælgere" (swapped); registered 8473 and 6738 voted read from the Tilsammen row and confirmed by candidate sums
